TARGET_AUDIENCE: Indian urban professionals and weekend explorers aged 23-32 who have repeatedly bookmarked Varanasi Ganga Aarti reels and want a focused 48-hour cultural escape, but hesitate because coordinating heritage stays, early morning boats, and flights feels fragmented across multiple apps.
PAIN_POINT: A 48-hour Varanasi weekend demands exact sequencing between dawn boat rides at Assi Ghat, evening Aarti crowds, and temple darshans, but booking the stay, domestic flights, and local activities across fragmented tabs means confirmation vouchers get buried and time slots fail to line up.
DESTINATION: Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India (Ghats and Old City circuit)
CREATIVE_ANGLE: They know they only have 48 hours to soak in the essential Banaras experience, but they do not know how to align tight flight arrivals with vehicle-free heritage ghat stays and sunrise boat bookings without juggling four confirmation apps. Travafa's Booking in the Plan lets them search and reserve their riverside hotel, flights, and curated morning boat directly inside their active 2-day schedule, automatically attaching every ticket, time slot, and location marker straight to the timeline.
LOOK_CONSTRAINTS: time_of_day: golden hour, warm low-angle sunlight; weather: clear sky, dry conditions; palette: warm earth tones, ochre and terracotta; film_look: anamorphic lens, wide cinematic flares; human_presence: one traveller, face visible
HOOK_STYLE: one character asks the other to guess a real, specific fact about the trip's difficulty or scale (a count, a duration, a distance - never a price or discount); the guess is wrong or underwhelming; the true fact is revealed and reframes the problem
PACING_SHAPE: keep problem, product and result close to equal thirds of the runtime
ENDING_STYLE: the character turns directly to camera in the final part and speaks the CTA themselves; the environment is present but secondary
DIALOGUE_DENSITY: concentrate dialogue in the earlier parts; let the later parts lean more on visual action and silence
MID_CALLOUT: a short capability callout, composited over the discovery beat - names only the capability just shown, never a number, price or discount
CharacterStyle: A 26-year-old Indian traveller in a relaxed terracotta-washed cotton half-sleeve shirt over an off-white linen tee, olive linen drawstring trousers, wearing a minimalist dark leather watch and carrying a compact tan canvas sling bag.
Setting: Stone steps of a peaceful upper ghat terrace overlooking the Ganges at golden hour, weathered ochre temple walls and carved stone balustrades bathed in warm low-angle sunlight, with the distant river haze in the background.
ReferenceTone: Cinematic documentary aesthetic, warm ochre and amber color grading, subtle anamorphic light flares, grounded and tactile travel texture without looking overly staged.
PhoneShotAction: Holds the smartphone naturally in both hands while seated on the ghat steps, tapping to book a heritage riverside stay and instantly seeing it pin into the morning slot of the 2-day itinerary on screen.
